subject: Finalizing panel swap backups & padding for Alex Soto's full loop
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-16T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft slot grid for Alex Soto — please flag swaps/backups

Hi all,

Attached is v3 of the slot grid for Alex Soto's full loop on 2028-11-02 (PDT). Karthik, per your request I grouped system design and ML infra on the morning block. Two asks before I lock calendars:

1) Confirm backups for any interviewers with likely conflicts — we need at least one backup per panel.
2) Decide padding between panels (15 vs. 30 minutes) — candidate is traveling and asked for short breaks, but we want time for evaluator notes.

Quick notes:
- Candidate timezone: PDT (Alex confirmed via agency).
- Panel order (proposed): 1) Hiring manager screen (30m) 2) System design (60m) 3) ML infra (45m) 4) Cross-functional / product sense (45m) 5) Final Q + wrap (30m).

Attachments: slot_grid_v3.pdf (grid with interviewer names/timezones)

Please reply with ANY swap requests today — I plan to send calendar holds by EOD.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-16T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft slot grid for Alex Soto — please flag swaps/backups

Thanks Neha — couple of quick conflicts on my side: I have a leadership review that overlaps the proposed 10:30-11:30 system design slot. Can we swap Laura into that slot (she has the 2:00pm buffer currently) and move her afternoon slot to me? If Laura can't, please hold Logan Wright as backup — he can cover system design at short notice.

Also: prefer 15-minute padding between 60m panels to keep candidate from being idle, but make sure there's a 30m buffer before the final Q for interviewer sync.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff ML Engineer (Hiring Manager)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-16T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft slot grid for Alex Soto — please flag swaps/backups

Marked Logan as backup and swapped Laura into the 10:30 system design slot in the attached runtable. A few practical day-of asks from my side (ops / interviewer experience):

- Add 5-minute buffer after each invite for quick note capture (we can use 15m padding as Karthik suggested but keep micro-buffers between 45/60 minute panels).
- I will own the runbook for the candidate (link in runbook-checklist.txt). Please do not add any extra back-to-back meetings for panel members before the loop.
- For accessibility: if Alex needs any adjustments, note them on the calendar invite so interviewers see it.

I've attached a short runbook-checklist.txt with day-of owner responsibilities and fallbacks for Zoom/recording issues.

Marissa
Sr. Technical Recruiting Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated plan + sign-off request — Alex Soto full loop

Thanks everyone — I updated the master sequence and attached panel_sequence_final.pdf. Summary of decisions:

- Laura moves to 10:30-11:30 (system design). Logan on hold as backup for 10:30.
- Padding: 15 minutes between panels; 30 minutes before final Q for evaluator sync.
- Runbook ownership: Marissa (day-of owner), Neha (candidate comms), Dylan (evaluator debrief coordinator).
- Attachments to include on invites: candidate resume (public), evaluation rubric, pre-read link to architecture doc.

Next steps:
1) Neha — send calendar invites with Zoom links and attach panel_sequence_final.pdf + runbook checklist.
2) Marissa — reserve Logan as a tentative for the morning and confirm no other scheduling conflicts for interviewers.
3) Karthik/Laura — confirm they're ok to swap formally.

Please reply with a quick "+1" if you sign off so I can lock invites.

Dylan
People Lead, Interview Experience
Redwood Inference

Attachments: panel_sequence_final.pdf

From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@gmail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Smith Talent <talent@smithsearch.com>
Date: 2028-10-16T12:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling for 2028-11-02 — Alex Soto

Hi Neha and team,

Thanks for sending the schedule. 15-minute padding works well for me — I prefer shorter breaks. I'm traveling to SF and will be in PDT. One quick note: I use live captioning sometimes for longer design discussions — can you enable auto-captions on the Zoom link or share an alternate accommodation?

Appreciate it,
Alex Soto
alex.soto@gmail.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated plan + sign-off request — Alex Soto full loop

+1 from me — I approve the swap and the padding plan. Two operational asks before you lock the calendar:

- Put backups (Logan) on short calendar hold with "tentative" so they don't schedule conflicting deep-work.
- Recruiters should send calendar invites that include: Zoom link with captions enabled, candidate CV, and the evaluation rubric. Also include a short note about accessibility accommodations so interviewers are prepped.

Once invites are out, loop me in on the post-loop debrief window (30m) and I'll join if schedules allow.

Vivek
Director of Product & Partner Strategy
Redwood Inference
